text:
Marta: Heading to Lisbon offsite — any quick tips for luggage/gear? Also thinking of leaving my work laptop in my room while day trips happen — yay or nay? :sweat_smile:
Aisha K.: Bring a small cable lock for the laptop. Works in hostels and hotels — loops around bed frame. TSA-approved.
Tom B.: Power strips: bring a compact one with USB-A/C ports. Europe sockets are wacky; get an EU+UK combo adapter. I use this one: https://amzn.to/example-adapter :plug:
Ravi P.: If you'll be in a hotel with a safe, keep the laptop in the safe when you go out. Otherwise lock + take it. Also enable FileVault and set a strong firmware password.
Marta: Good call. Firmware PW — hadn't thought of that. Is that overkill?
Aisha K.: Not overkill if it's not cloud-backed. Also enable remote wipe and have backups. :white_check_mark:
Tom B.: Pack earbuds + a 1L dry bag for day trips — good for beach days. And label chargers with a bit of colorful tape.
Liam (ops-bot): Reminder: Redwood offsite reimbursement policy applies to adapters/locks under misc gear. See link: https://company.internal/expenses :money_with_wings:
Ravi P.: Also — if anyone wants to swap adapters or spare 2-prong plugs, I can bring extras. Drop a note.
Marta: Ooh can I borrow a UK adapter for the last night? My flight delayed so I'll be in London for a few hrs.
Aisha K.: @Marta I've got one. Meet in lobby before dinner? :thumbsup:
Tom B.: quick packing snippet:
```
- Laptop + cable lock
- Compact power strip (4 outlets + 2 USB-C)
- EU/UK adapter
- Travel SSD + encrypted backup
```
Marta: Perfect. Thanks all! I'll also post a mini checklist in the offsite channel later. :party_popper:
